title: LTX23-Masterpiece-Creation
global_style: museum-grade cinematic realism, controlled studio lighting, rich texture detail, no text, no watermark, sharp focus, high dynamic range

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A master artist's studio before dawn, an empty linen canvas on a wooden easel, jars of pigment, sharpened charcoal, marble dust, gold leaf, and brushes arranged with ritual precision, soft blue window light and one warm desk lamp
scenes.video_prompt: The empty canvas waits in a quiet master artist studio, dust motes drift through blue dawn light, a warm lamp glows over pigments and brushes, camera slowly pushes toward the canvas
scenes.camera: slow forward dolly, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field
scenes.motion: dust motes drifting, lamp glow subtly flickering, curtains barely moving
scenes.style: tactile realism, painterly but photoreal, crisp canvas fibers, no blur

scenes.storyboard_prompt: Close-up of the artist's hand drawing the first charcoal line on the canvas, powdered charcoal texture visible, knuckles and brush hairs sharply detailed, the first elegant curve beginning a masterpiece
scenes.video_prompt: A hand draws the first charcoal line on raw canvas, charcoal dust falls in tiny particles, the line grows into an elegant curve, camera tracks the moving hand in macro detail
scenes.camera: macro tracking shot, 85mm lens, shallow but sharp focus on charcoal tip
scenes.motion: hand gliding, charcoal particles falling, line appearing progressively
scenes.style: ultra detailed handcraft realism, crisp edges, zero smear

scenes.storyboard_prompt: A palette knife mixing deep ultramarine, crimson lake, titanium white, and gold pigment on a glass palette, thick oil paint ridges glossy and dimensional under studio light
scenes.video_prompt: A palette knife folds ultramarine, crimson, white, and gold pigment together, glossy oil paint ridges move and catch the light, camera orbits slowly around the glass palette
scenes.camera: slow macro orbit, 100mm lens, high detail
scenes.motion: paint folding, highlights sliding across wet pigment, palette knife scraping softly
scenes.style: luxury macro realism, high texture, sharp wet paint detail

scenes.storyboard_prompt: The masterpiece emerging on canvas: luminous portrait and abstract gold geometry, layers of brushwork, precise highlights, the artist's hand applying final strokes with a fine sable brush
scenes.video_prompt: A luminous masterpiece emerges on canvas as the artist applies precise final brush strokes, gold geometry catches the light, paint layers shimmer, camera rises from brush tip to full artwork reveal
scenes.camera: controlled crane up from brush tip to artwork, 35mm lens
scenes.motion: brush stroke appearing, gold leaf shimmer, subtle hand movement, reveal upward
scenes.style: gallery quality realism, crisp brush detail, no flicker, no deformation

scenes.storyboard_prompt: Finished masterpiece in a dark gallery, dramatic spotlight on the artwork, the artist standing in silhouette, visitors blurred only in the far background, polished floor reflection, sense of awe
scenes.video_prompt: The finished masterpiece hangs in a dark gallery under a dramatic spotlight, the artist stands in silhouette, polished floor reflections glow, camera slowly pulls back to reveal the room and audience hush
scenes.camera: slow pullback, symmetrical gallery composition, 40mm lens
scenes.motion: subtle spotlight shimmer, reflections breathing, camera pulling back, viewers barely shifting
scenes.style: prestige museum realism, cinematic ending, sharp artwork, no text
